description: `sort_by` and `max_by` -- tier 9 has `sort_by`; `max_by` is its `nilable`-returning sibling (nil on an empty receiver), and `range_status` ends with `past_fixes.max_by { |v| Version.new(v) }` feeding a field that is declared nilable for exactly that reason.
sorbet_note: Method `+` does not exist on `NilClass` component of `T.nilable(String)`
